Name: Shane HD Portraits by Hemptress
Author: Hemptress
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]🐔 Shane HD Portraits by Hemptress
Pelican Town’s resident grump just got an HD upgrade.
[b]Shane HD Portraits by Hemptress[/b] gives Shane a more detailed, expressive, semi-realistic redesign while keeping him recognizable to his vanilla Stardew Valley appearance.
This portrait pack keeps his messy dark hair, tired eyes, casual clothes, rough-around-the-edges personality, and unmistakable Shane energy, while refining his features with a stronger build, sharper facial structure, fuller lips, thicker lashes, and more expressive poses.
He still looks like he does not want to talk to you.
He just looks significantly better doing it. 🖤[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [b]SMAPI[/b].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [b]Portraiture[/b].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download [b]Shane HD Portraits by Hemptress[/b].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Extract the downloaded folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Place the portrait folder inside:[/color][/*]
[/list][code]Stardew Valley/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/[/code][list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Speak to Shane and use Portraiture’s portrait-selection controls to select the Hemptress portrait set if needed.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]That’s it.
Your local chicken enthusiast is now considerably more photogenic. 🐔✨[/color]

[/list][heading][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]🖤 The Redesign[/color][/size][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8]The goal of this portrait pack was to enhance Shane without completely reinventing him.
He still has that exhausted, guarded, slightly scruffy look that fits his character, but with more refined anatomy, stronger facial features, richer expression work, and a more mature overall appearance.
His portraits range from annoyed and sarcastic to softer, happier expressions as his relationship with the player develops.
And yes, the blue chickens still have him wrapped around their tiny feathered fingers.
[/color]
[heading][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]🐓 Story-Friendly Expressions[/color][/size][/heading]

[*][color=#D4D4D8]And a few appropriately chaotic Shane moments[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]The aim is to make conversations with him feel more expressive without losing the personality of the original character.
[/color]
[heading][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]🌴 Beach Portraits[/color][/size][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8]A matching beach portrait set is included so Shane keeps his redesigned appearance when visiting Ginger Island.
Same attitude.
Less shirt.
More tropical sunshine. ☀️🐔[/color]
